checkpoint_note: A21 runs, trained on ablation_v10_both_seed{0,1,2}; these are independent draws from full_dataset_phase1_v10 and exact-row overlap with every split evaluated here is zero
baselines: conditions-only conditional median (MC estimate of the conditions-only Bayes risk under absolute loss)
pairwise_accuracy_scope: pooled across conditions within each split; NOT the within-tuple accuracy of the replicate test set, and not comparable to it
aggregation: mean over 9 runs (3 dataset realizations x 3 training seeds)
training: none; evaluation of existing A21 checkpoints only
